findings.detail: Two Chartbeat subordinated-debt rows falsely encode SOFR although the source index is blank and the 16.00% spread is explicitly PIK.
The AGS revolver and delayed-draw rows inherited SOFR, 5.50%, and 9.17% from the funded loan even though their own source terms are blank.

rationale: Class 2 source-row review proves all four flagged identifiers contain an unsupported SOFR reference. Chartbeat rows 9-10 disclose no index and label 16.00% as PIK; AGS rows 34-35 disclose no index, spread, or interest rate, unlike the adjacent funded loan at row 33. The flag is therefore a real extraction error, not an uncorroborated-source false alarm.
